text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You have arrived, my noble lady. I 
have summoned you here for no other reason 
than—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A celebration born from the maternal 
abyss... Upon thee who hast welcomed this 
auspicious day, shall we not offer the 
blessings of the gods!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You are always so self-absorbed—and yet. 
The tone of your sound is foolishly, 
purely honest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Far more than those unrefined folks who 
offer nothing but empty flattery.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...I am honored, fair goddess of beauty. 
Your praise intoxicates me more deeply 
than any sweet nectar."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Yet—who do you picture as you speak? Only 
the two of us exist in this sanctuary of 
celebration.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Look at me, my bewitching lady.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Rather than yearning for it... Wouldn't it 
suit you better to forcefully tie it down?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—You should simply intoxicate them. With 
your own hands, that is.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I gladly accept your challenge! Come, 
maiden of Aries, blessed by Taurus! Allow 
me to welcome you to a banquet of luscious 
delights!!
